title: 12 · Pixel art · Lampwright
strengths: Pixel art only where a live-ops tool would show the game's own art: the event key art (328x70 art pixels at 4x), item sprites beside offers, the logo and the avatar; every number and control is Onest with tabular figures

The scene is composed: a plume of lanterns rising from the pier and drifting right, sized 5x6, 3x4, 2x2 then one pixel as they rise, dithered sky, a quiet sky behind the title, the moon and its reflection

Data a studio would read: DAU 1.84M, revenue 24 h $412.9K, ARPDAU $0.224 (= revenue / DAU), D1 retention 41.8% (-1.3 pts, the only red), 63.4% joined the event with 2.31M lanterns released, revenue per hour against last year's festival with a 'Now · 14:06' marker
Gold has one meaning (the live event): the kicker, the day bar, the event KPI and the 2026 line
slop_signals: The pixel style lives only in one banner; the rest is a generic dark KPI dashboard (six sparkline tiles, a yellow accent, a line chart), which styles.md calls decoration sprinkled on top
The 'Paper Crane Pack' sprite does not read as a crane at its size
KPI tiles with sparklines and dashed event markers are the same pattern shipped analytics tools use
fixes: Carry the grid into the data: stepped bars for revenue per hour, pixel sprites as tier markers in the KPIs, a pixel progress bar, so the style shapes the whole surface
Rename Signalfire (SignalFire is a real venture capital firm)
Fix the end date and the revenue against offer sales (below)
